post.description:
登录并创建会话
Public credential exchange; no existing bearer/access cookie is required. The body returns token strings for native clients and the response sets HttpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies (SameSite=Lax, Path=/, configurable Secure).
A login attempt reconciles an elapsed timed moderation ban before the password and two-factor checks. Previously revoked sessions stay revoked.

access_token.description: Signed access JWT returned to native clients; also set as access_token HttpOnly cookie.

refresh_token.description: Signed refresh JWT returned to native clients; also set as refresh_token HttpOnly cookie. Rotated on refresh.

two_factor_required.description: False for an issued login session; true when a two-factor challenge must be completed.

data.description: A successful issued session contains two_factor_required=false, user and tokens. A pending 2FA result instead contains two_factor_required=true, challenge_id, account and expires_at; it does not yet issue user/tokens.

patch.description: Refresh the current session using refresh_token cookie, or JSON refresh_token when the cookie is absent. delete.description: Requires an active access session, current password and confirmation equal to the current username or case-insensitive DELETE. Anonymizes/disables the account, soft-deletes its posts/comments, revokes its sessions and clears auth cookies. No query parameters are read. Service v2Throw attaches {code, message, data:null, meta:null} to H3 error.data; the handler rethrows it. Framework HTTP error rendering is not asserted to equal the success envelope at the top level. Feature schema changes are performed only by the explicit migration tool; request readiness checks are read-only. 四步软注销现在在同一事务中提交；最终账号更新绑定原密码哈希和active状态，零行回滚409。提交/连接关闭错误不证明未提交，不自动重放。presence仅最佳努力；不是物理删除或完整个人数据擦除，具体范围见auth-account-deletion.md。 两客户端完整成功响应解码及兼容附加字段规则见auth-security-client-response.md；失败不自动重放，不据解析失败断言事务未提交。
